title: Towards Detecting AI-Assisted Responses in Online Surveys
abstract: arXiv:2609.17317v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The use of LLMs to complete online surveys impacts the validity of survey-based research, but detecting such usage remains underexplored. We introduce an initial benchmark dataset, namely ASURRE, for AI-assisted survey participation to capture usage strategies ranging from full generation and revision to persona-grounded agentic completion. Controlled by these strategies, LLM-assisted survey responses are generated using multiple LLMs on three real-world surveys in different disciplines, paired with genuine human responses. Our evaluation of existing machine-generated text (MGT) detectors shows that naive AI usage is readily detectable, whereas persona-grounded agents that mimic entire respondents push detector performance toward chance. We further show that agentic completion cannot fully replicate respondent-level behaviour and leaves distinctive behavioural traces. translated_title: 面向在线调查中AI辅助回答的检测
translated_abstract: 使用大语言模型（LLM）完成在线调查会影响基于调查的研究的有效性，但对检测此类使用行为的探索仍然不足。我们引入了一个名为ASURRE的AI辅助调查参与的初步基准数据集，涵盖从完整生成、修改到基于人设的智能体完成等多种使用策略。在这些策略的控制下，我们使用多个LLM在三个不同学科的真实调查中生成了LLM辅助的调查回答，并与真实的人类回答进行配对。我们对现有机器生成文本（MGT）检测器的评估表明，简单的AI使用方式很容易被检测到，而模仿完整受访者的基于人设的智能体则使检测器的性能接近随机猜测水平。我们进一步表明，智能体完成无法完全复制受访者层面的行为，并会留下独特的行为痕迹。虽然个体线索可以通过有针对性的提示来规避，但……
tldr: 本文提出了首个AI辅助调查参与基准数据集ASURRE，发现基于人设的智能体回答能使现有机器生成文本检测器接近随机水平，但智能体无法完全复制受访者行为并会留下可利用的行为痕迹。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces ASURRE, the first benchmark dataset for AI-assisted survey participation, showing that persona-grounded agents push existing MGT detectors toward chance performance, yet agentic completion leaves distinctive behavioural traces at the respondent level.
